items.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
items.excerpt: FOSS, Basically it plugs into your existing coding agent workflow and every time you push to prod it'll throw up a questionnaire that checks if you understand how the code you're pushing works.
items.summary: Sphinx is a FOSS hook that integrates with AI coding agent workflows and presents a questionnaire before production deployment to verify code understanding.
items.usefulness: If building Python tools with agent assistance, could help confirm the generated code's logic before shipping to catch integration gaps.
items.to_verify: Whether the questionnaire reliably identifies genuine misunderstandings versus superficial knowledge; what code patterns it covers.
